page.title: Languages
page.description: Languages your content can be written in. Sites ask for one and get the default language when a translation is missing.

form.codeHint: Lowercase, for example en, cs or de-at. It cannot be changed later.
form.codeInvalid: Use a code such as en, cs or de-at
form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name of up to 50 characters

confirm.defaultText: Sites that do not ask for a language get {{name}}, and missing translations fall back to it.
confirm.deleteText_one: This also deletes {{count}} entry version in {{name}}. Sites stop receiving it.
confirm.deleteText_other: This also deletes {{count}} entry versions in {{name}}. Sites stop receiving them.
confirm.deleteNone: No entry has a version in {{name}}.
